facts: The MCP tool named delete_object exposes exactly bucket and key inputs.
The handler calls deleteObject(bucket, key).
No ETag, If-Match, version, revision, or conditional-precondition input is exposed by this tool surface.
deleteObject accepts only bucket and key.
deleteObject sends new DeleteObjectCommand({ Bucket: bucket, Key: key }).
No IfMatch or other version-bound conditional field is supplied before the delete effect.
The deleteObject test invokes deleteObject with bucket and key only.
The test requires the SDK command input to equal Bucket plus Key with no conditional field.
The target declares @aws-sdk/client-s3 with range ^3.700.0.
The exact target lock resolves node_modules/@aws-sdk/client-s3 to version 3.994.0.
DeleteObject accepts If-Match.
With If-Match, S3 deletes only when the supplied ETag matches the object's ETag.
An ETag mismatch returns 412 Precondition Failed.
Conditional DeleteObject can use If-Match with an ETag to check whether an object changed.
Matching ETag succeeds with 204 No Content; mismatching ETag fails with 412 Precondition Failed.
Conditional delete evaluation applies to the current object version.

authoritative_source_evidence.authority: AWS official SDK for JavaScript v3 documentation
facts: DeleteObjectRequest includes IfMatch as a string input.
IfMatch is defined with the same ETag-match / 412-mismatch semantics.

authoritative_source_evidence.authority: AWS official S3 document history / What's New
facts: Amazon S3 added conditional deletes for general purpose buckets on 2025-09-16.
AWS stated the feature is available through the S3 API, SDKs, and CLI.

dependency_timing.conclusion: The conditional-delete capability predates the target's locked AWS SDK version; omission cannot be attributed to a pre-feature SDK dependency.

open_evidence_limits: AWS latest documentation is a retrieval-time official source rather than a repository-pinned immutable AWS documentation object.
No live destructive S3 call is required because the source conditional semantics and pinned target request shape are directly documented and statically observable.
